name: Neon ring text reveal
what: A neon ring spins shut on a dark ground, stutters off and on, contracts to the middle while a soft disc of the same colour opens from it, and a glowing word appears inside; the word holds with a faint flicker and one letter that twitches.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f4-f28 (00:00:00:04-00:00:00:28) a neon ring is drawn from the top clockwise and grows as it spins shut, three finer rings following it a few frames apart; f32-f33 and f36 (00:00:01:02-00:00:01:06) the ring stutters off; f40-f66 (00:00:01:10-00:00:02:06) the rings contract to the middle, the thick one fastest, and fade; f63-f78 (00:00:02:03-00:00:02:18) a soft disc opens from the middle, widens and fades while the word appears inside it and its glow builds; then it holds with a faint flicker to f119 (00:00:03:29)
